text: The Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee met on April 8, 2019 to review the Medical Officer of Health's 2018 Performance Planner and 2019 Work Plan (see Item HP1.1). The above recommendations are forwarded to the Board of Health for its consideration.

The Board of Health: 1. Approved Confidential Recommendation 1 in Confidential Attachment 1 to the letter (April 8, 2019) from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the letter (April 8, 2019) from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee and Confidential Attachment 3 from the Medical Officer of Health remain confidential, as they contain personal information about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees.
